title: JobHunterCoverLetter
description: The body of one cover letter for a saved job: the salutation, the paragraphs and the closing. The app prints the header above the salutation and my name below the closing.

job_id.description: The job id from the input, copied unchanged.

language.description: Language of every text field in this object, as a two-letter lower-case ISO 639-1 code, chosen by the kit language rule in the profile's Standard answers section.

salutation.description: The greeting the letter opens with, as the template words it. Never my own name.

paragraphs.description: Three to seven paragraphs of body text in reading order, shaped as the template sets out. Each item is one paragraph of flowing prose: no line break inside it, no heading, no bullet, no [Tailor: ...] slot left in it.

items.description: One paragraph of prose. No compensation figure, rate or currency, no start date, availability or notice period, no contact details. No exclamation marks, no chains of em dashes, no not-just-X-but-Y constructions.

closing.description: The closing phrase only, as the template words it. The app prints my name below it.
